listing.name: Rayman 2: The Great Escape (n64hub)
listing.summary: A Windows port of Rayman 2: The Great Escape. Set it up with your original US Nintendo 64 game file.

steps.title: Prepare the game
steps.instruction: Install the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (x64) if needed. On first start, choose Load ROM and select your own 32 MiB, big-endian Rayman 2 USA .z64 (SHA-1 50558356b059ad3fbaf5fe95380512b9dceaaf52), then choose Start Game. The player checks the file and keeps a copy in its profile; keep your original separately.

warnings: Keep your current profile and Controller Pak files when replacing the program. The project reports early-game progress. Later levels and save compatibility across releases are unverified.
The package includes Chiaro fonts by Fontworks that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.

references.title: Upstream releases and their setup notes

data_locations: %LOCALAPPDATA%/Rayman2Recompiled by default, or the game folder if it already uses portable.txt; saves/controllerpak_1.mpk and other Controller Pak files under that profile

preparation.title: Set up the managed copy on first Play
preparation.instruction: Use Load ROM to select your own 32 MiB, big-endian Rayman 2 USA .z64 (SHA-1 50558356b059ad3fbaf5fe95380512b9dceaaf52). The player verifies it and keeps a private copy in its profile with settings and Controller Pak files. Back up that profile separately before changing versions.

warnings: Use a separate upstream copy for portable.txt mode. A separately prepared copy without portable.txt uses the same %LOCALAPPDATA%\Rayman2Recompiled profile as the managed copy.
